voices.name: Tobi - Clear, Steady and Calm African English     Voice  (Explainers and Corporates)
voices.description: A calm, clear African English narration voice suitable for explainers, corporate presentations, audiobooks, and educational content. Tobi’s  delivery is steady and neutral, designed for long-form listening without fatigue.

voices.name: Aarav J - Cool Wise Friend
voices.description: Aarav delivers a cool, smart, and conversational tone that feels like a wise friend speaking naturally. His relaxed yet intelligent delivery makes explanations sound thoughtful without feeling preachy or dramatic. Ideal for social storytelling, life advice content, relatable commentary, educational shorts, and conversational AI interactions. Performs especially well on Social Media platforms and modern creator-led content.

voices.name: Krish - Bright Joyful
voices.description: Warm, buoyant, and genuinely excited — Krish moves through the full range of happiness, from quiet contentment to full celebration, without ever sounding forced. His energetic, real delivery captures joy the way it actually builds, staying clear even at its most animated. Built for character voiceover, game NPCs, animation, and upbeat storytelling. Ideal for game studios, kids content, and interactive fiction needing genuine happiness.

voices.name: Bholu - Cute Innocent Kid
voices.description: Bubbly, wide-eyed, and full of wonder — Bholu reacts to everything like it's the first time, peaking with genuine excitement at just the right moments. His animated delivery brings warmth and charm to every scene without ever feeling exaggerated for its own sake. Built for cartoons, kids shows, animated series, and children's storytelling content. Ideal for animation studios, kids content platforms, and family entertainment brands.

voices.name: Kishan - Cheerful Natural Soft
voices.description:
A lively and expressive Hindi voice crafted for playful characters, smart bots, and engaging content.

Kishan’s animated tone adds charm and energy to AI companions, interactive bots, e-learning kids’ apps, and cartoon-style content. Whether you're building character-driven experiences or fun explainers, his voice fits right in on platforms like YouTube, Instagram Reels, interactive learning tools, and voice-first games.

voices.name: Bhola - Soft Innocent Cheerful
voices.description:
A soft, curious, and adorably innocent voice that sounds like a cheerful young learner—ideal for light-hearted storytelling or playful explainer content.

Perfect for educational voiceovers, animated explainer videos, bedtime audio stories, and young character dialogues. Works well on platforms like Khan Academy Kids, Doubtnut, Toppr, and Vedantu—especially for engaging primary-level audiences with a friendly tone.

voices.name: Roos - Kind, Articulate and Confident
voices.description: Fresh, young, warm, cheerful, accessible female voice.

voices.name: Seva - Cheering Companion
voices.description: Seva brings an infectious energy that makes you want to take on the day. Her enthusiastic, caring delivery combines the warmth of a best friend with the motivating presence of a personal cheerleader — celebrating your wins, pushing you forward, and always in your corner. Built for motivating AI companion apps, accountability partner experiences, and uplifting daily check-in platforms.

voices.name: Deshna - Magical Kids Voice
voices.description: A soothing voice crafted for children’s audiobooks, kids’ storytime podcasts, and edutainment platforms. With the perfect blend of playfulness and clarity, she turns every kid’s and child’s story into a magical experience. Daughter of Priyanka and niece of Monika Sogam — two of ElevenLabs’ most successful voice artists — Deshna carries forward the legacy with a voice made to delight children and kids alike on Social media and educational apps

voices.name: Niharika - Kids Storyteller
voices.description: Clear, warm, and built to hold a child's attention through every scene. Niharika brings each character to life with consistent delivery and expressive range — her Hindi narration keeps young viewers engaged without ever feeling forced or over-performed. Built for animated kids' series, visual story voiceovers, children's apps, school content platforms, and OTT kids' content where the narrator is the emotional anchor of every episode.

voices.name: Ravneet - Kids Storyteller
voices.description: A bubbly, friendly, expressive and playful English female voice designed for children’s learning, educational content, storytelling and e-learning projects. Warm, clear and easy to understand.

voices.name: Cleo-Youthful Irish female voice
voices.description: Youthful Irish female voice, calm, conversational with neutral accent.

voices.name: Dorothy - British Children's Storyteller
voices.description: Dorothy - A warm, velvety alto with a slow, unhurried cadence and gentle, rounded tones. Her voice carries a natural stillness. Deeply grounding and soothing, ideal for guided meditation, breathwork, affirmations, and wellness content.

voices.name: Sia – The Commercial Ad Voice
voices.description: Sia is excited, expressive, and instantly attention-grabbing — her voice cuts through whether it is a 30-second TV spot, a radio jingle, or a Spotify pre-roll. Her delivery feels energetic and attractive without tipping into overdone. Ideal for FMCG brands, retail campaigns, telecom ads, OTT promotions, and D2C product launches. A strong fit for advertising agencies, media production houses, and brand teams running high-volume commercial campaigns across broadcast and digital platforms.

voices.name: Kalpana G – Casual GenZ Creator
voices.description: Real, good for Vlogs, and completely unfiltered — Kalpana G sounds like someone you already follow. Her GenZ energy feels lived-in and natural, the kind that makes daily vlogs feel like genuine moments rather than produced content. Built for daily vlogs, casual social media content, lifestyle storytelling, and creator-led campaigns. Ideal for youth brands, lifestyle labels, and digital creators building an audience that values realness over perfection.

voices.name: Bheem-Confident,friendly,nice & natural
voices.description: Connect with people, perfect for narration, character voice & social media use.

voices.name: Kiran – Very Young Adorable Storyteller
voices.description: Kiran brings a sweet, cute, and warmly engaging tone to story narration. Her young, gentle delivery draws listeners in instantly — perfect for children's stories, bedtime narration, and family-friendly audio content. Ideal for kids' audiobook platforms, children's apps, and animated story content where a naturally adorable voice makes every story feel magical.

voices.name: Ayu-Education,Story,Podcast,SocialMedia
voices.description: A Young Indian female voice ideal for educational content, storytelling, and social media. Capable of both calm, soothing meditation tones and energetic, engaging delivery for reels and videos.

voices.name: Amara | Calm & Intellectual Narrator
voices.description: Calm, stable, and approachable narrator featuring a gentle, clear Indian accent. Optimized for long-form educational documentaries and thoughtful video essays, this voice provides a trustworthy tone that maintains listener engagement. It offers a unique, hushed sophistication and professional clarity, making it the perfect fit for everything from deep-dive history projects to soothing mindfulness guides.

voices.name: Devi – The Engaging Tutor Voice
voices.description: Devi makes learning feel easy. Her tone is sweet, clear, and naturally encouraging — the kind of voice that keeps students engaged without making content feel like a chore. Built for e-learning modules, online courses, skill training, and educational explainers where clarity and warmth drive completion rates. Ideal for EdTech platforms, corporate training programs, school content producers, and course creators who want their students to actually enjoy the experience.

voices.name: Karthik | Indian AI Voice
voices.description: A clear and natural Indian English voice ideal for AI content, e-learning, Social Media narration, and professional presentations. Suitable for explainers, tutorials, storytelling, and conversational voiceovers with a balanced, engaging, and professional tone.

voices.name: Arin | Deep, Assured, Warm
voices.description: Indian English male baritone with a warm, assured, polished tone. Clear diction, steady pacing and a credible, modern delivery. Best for brand films, corporate narration, explainers, promos, podcasts and premium digital content.

voices.name: Sekhar - Warm & Energetic
voices.description: A warm, lively, and expressive voice that brings energy without sounding harsh. Ideal for educational content, digital courses, presentations, brand videos, and engaging narration. It combines clarity, confidence, and friendliness, making it easy for listeners to stay connected from start to finish.

voices.name: Bella - Professional, Bright, Warm
